about: Aphex Twin - Hedphelym (Selected Ambient Works 85-92), built from the official album master's stems. Drums programmed on the record's 124.958 BPM grid from the drum stem: 8th-note kick and hats with per-hit levels; a sustained juno-pad guide from the 'other' stem plus the C6 voice-pad of 205-232 s; a quiet low guide and wordless voice gestures. Master: per-section level, stereo width, section EQ and contour rides fitted to the record.
